cohort: 61 infants with developmental delay (cases) and 61 infants without developmental delay (controls) aged 6 months to 6 years attending Acharya Vinoba Bhave Rural Hospital, Sawangi (Meghe) in Maharashtra
finding: Maternal infections, chronic diseases during pregnancy, caesarean section, failure to cry after birth, and absence of breastfeeding were significantly associated with developmental delay in children aged 6 months to 6 years.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to be a significant risk factor for developmental delay.
